assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.x HAS a user shell escape — a change from the V1 column, whose 1.x agent had none. `POST /api/session/{id}/shell` (2.1.4 openapi: "Execute one shell command in the session's working directory") runs the command with no model turn. Probed on the sandbox service (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-15-shell.log): `echo hello` wrote ONE `shell` row (command, status exited, exit 0, output) and no idle row; the next prompt's turn began with a `synthetic` row ("The following shell command was executed by the user …") before its user row.

## What the daemon has to do

The scenario: the escape is not a turn, so the session stays ready through it; a real prompt afterwards still drives ready → working → ready. On 2.x the shell row is new store activity on a ready session. parser_v2.go reads no `shell` row (it falls through to the 1.x switch and is skipped), and #2120 skips a turn-end tail after a hook-ended ready, so it is expected to leave the session ready — measured by this recording, not assumed.
caveats: The shell escape is driven over the API (the driver's `shell` step); a TUI user types `!cmd`. Both reach the service's same shell endpoint.
The next turn's `synthetic` row is a 2.x shape parser_v2.go does not read (#2127's finding 2); the turn is still ended by its idle row and Stop hook.

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)

2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
probe: POST /shell wrote one shell row (exited) and no idle row; the next turn began with a synthetic row

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)
one turn, then the user shell escape `echo hello` over the API, then a second turn

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: alive. Do not use any tools.

verify: the shell escape: the session stays ready (no working, no waiting) — it is not a turn
turn 2 still drives ready → working → ready on the same session
